findings.claim: Natural-gas futures volatility declines with contract horizon; near-dated contracts are more volatile than farther maturities.
findings.mechanism: Information and physical scarcity shocks become increasingly relevant as delivery approaches.
findings.caveat: Ergen and Rizvanoghlu report the time-to-maturity effect as season-dependent, present in winter in their specification.

findings.claim: Natural-gas futures exhibit material seasonal structure in prices, convenience yield and curve shape.
findings.mechanism: Strong seasonal demand and inventory cycles alter scarcity and the value of physical availability.
findings.expected_direction: winter and injection-season curve states differ systematically

sources.scope: direct energy-commodity evidence including Henry Hub natural gas

contextual_sources.scope: commodity-futures seasonality methodology; empirical application is heating oil, not direct Henry Hub evidence
